description: This file defines extension functions for the AnalyticsHelper class to log various analytics events related to user interactions such as bookmarking news resources, following topics, changing themes, and onboarding state.

methods.name: logNewsResourceBookmarkToggled
methods.description: Logs an event when a news resource is bookmarked or unbookmarked, capturing the news resource ID and the bookmark state.

methods.name: logTopicFollowToggled
methods.description: Logs an event when a topic follow or unfollow action occurs, capturing the topic ID and follow state.

methods.name: logThemeChanged
methods.description: Logs an event when the theme is changed, capturing the name of the selected theme.

methods.name: logDarkThemeConfigChanged
methods.description: Logs an event when the dark theme configuration is changed, capturing the configuration name.

methods.name: logDynamicColorPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Logs an event when the dynamic color preference is toggled, capturing the boolean value.

methods.name: logOnboardingStateChanged
methods.description: Logs an event when the onboarding state changes, indicating whether onboarding is complete or reset.
